title: Monthly Membership
evidence_sentence: The classes page lists a Monthly Membership at Cider Creek, where the collective is known for atmospheric firing with wood.
evidence_quote: Nick and Jess focus on clean, ecologically responsible practices that work in tandem with land stewardship, like atmospheric firing with wood
summary: An ongoing monthly membership at $200/month for access to Cider Creek Collective's studio and wood-firing opportunities.
